articles.title: Democratizing weather derivatives through tokenization could be crypto's most important real-world use case
articles.snippet: Main Street, which faces the most significant climate-related financial risk, currently lacks an avenue to hedge weather-related risks, argues CoinDesk’s Omkar Godbole.

articles.title: Robinhood Chain's real-world assets jump fivefold as tokenized stocks start trading in bigger size
articles.snippet: The chain built to put equities onchain has tripled in size since mid-July, and a dozen tokenized stocks are now each clearing $500,000 a day. Real-world assets are growing fast, though memecoins and stablecoins still dominate the chain.

articles.title: Brazilian farmers tokenized dairy cows to get loans, bypassing bank lending limits
articles.snippet: Smart collars monitor herd health in real time to prevent fraud, allowing local agricultural businesses to secure thousands in funding backed by livestock.

articles.title: Stocks Just Topped Crypto on Hyperliquid. ARK Says That Changes Everything
articles.snippet: For the first time, real-world assets—stocks, commodities, and market indices—outpaced crypto on the world's biggest decentralized derivatives exchange.

articles.title: Kraken Parent Company Makes Moves to Offer xStocks From Global Markets
articles.snippet: Payward and fintech GTN are teaming up to bring xStocks—blockchain-based copies of real company shares—to Hong Kong, the UK, Europe, and South Korea.
